instruction: Reopen the tab that was most recently closed.

metadata.explanation: Task variation using entertainment/media websites (youtube.com, netflix.com, spotify.com). User needs to bring back the just-closed tab (spotify.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator checks if all 3 tabs are open using the existing is_expected_tabs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct for verifying the instruction
Getter 'get_open_tabs_info' correctly extracts all open tab URLs from Chrome browser
Metric 'is_expected_tabs' properly compares actual tab URLs against expected URLs using URL-aware comparison
Expected value correctly specifies all 3 tabs (YouTube, Netflix, Spotify) that should be present after bringing back the closed tab
Complete coverage: The instruction requires bringing back the closed Spotify tab, and the evaluator verifies all 3 tabs are open
Data flow is correct: getter returns List[Dict] with 'url' keys, metric extracts URLs and compares with expected list
No state timing issues: tab state is persistent and accessible without requiring postconfig
